serving_temperature_items.item_ja: 朝の冷たいスムージー

notes:
49 foods coded (29 warm / 19 cool / 1 neutral).

[EXCLUDED — §8 substitute-recommendation precedent]
- 黒砂糖・はちみつ (L98-99): 「白砂糖（体を冷やす）の代わりに使える天然甘味料」— framed only as substitutes for white sugar, no nature attribution of their own. TENSION FLAGGED: they sit inside the block headed 「5. その他の温め食材」(L84) / 「料理にプラスするだけで温め効果アップ」(L87), so a strict §3 column-header reading would make both warm. §8 explicitly names karada_onkatsu はちみつ as a dropped substitute row, so I followed §8 and dropped both. If the author instead applies the header rule, 黒砂糖 and はちみつ should be added as warm (L98).
- 玄米 (L109): 「黒砂糖・玄米に切り替えるだけで変わります」— substitute recommendation only, no nature stated (matches the §8 karada_onkatsu 玄米 precedent).

[EXCLUDED — prepared beverage, §8 白湯/生姜湯 precedent]
- しょうが湯 (L104, also L99): listed among 温め飲み物 but it is a prepared drink, not a food's nature.
- 白湯 (L42, L46, L129): a vehicle for ginger powder; no direction attributed to it anywhere.
- しょうが紅茶 (L42): prepared drink, no separate attribution.
- 生姜パウダー（乾燥しょうが）(L45-46): PR/ad block for a product; same item as 加熱・乾燥しょうが (already coded, L39).

[EXCLUDED — no direction stated]
- 醤油 (L127): appears only as 「サラダのドレッシングに醤油や味噌を使う」 in a combining tip; a warming nature is implied by context but never stated. 味噌 is coded warm from L73 instead.
- 乳製品 (L115, as 「発酵前の乳製品」) and 肉類 (L96, as 「体を温める性質の肉類」) and 地下鱗茎類 (L64): treated as descriptive qualifiers of the specific items listed rather than standalone umbrella labels; the concrete items (牛乳 / 羊肉・鶏肉 / にんにく・たまねぎ) are coded.

[STRUCTURAL ROW HEADERS] None found. No label appears identically under both the warming and the cooling side of this source.

[CONDITION SPLITS]
- しょうが: source splits 生しょうが (L37-38, surface/temporary warming) vs 加熱・乾燥しょうが (L39-40, deep/sustained warming). BOTH are warm — this is not a warm/cool split. Coded as three rows (しょうが, 生しょうが, 加熱・乾燥しょうが) since all three labels are verbatim and each carries its own warming statement; collapse to one ginger key if the author prefers.
- 豆腐→納豆 and 牛乳→ヨーグルト: the source states fermentation flips the direction (L76, L125). Coded as separate foods, not as conditions.

[DUPLICATE FOOD KEYS to watch at aggregation]
- 豆腐 (L76, cool) and 白豆腐 (L114, cool) are the same food under two verbatim labels; both coded because both appear verbatim.
- 甘酒 appears under both the fermented-foods warm block (L77) and the 温め飲み物 line (L104) — same direction, coded once.
- 緑茶/麦茶 appear at L104 and again at L118-119 — same direction (cool), coded once each.
- 白砂糖 appears at L28, L99, L108 — cool in all three, coded once.

[AMBIGUITY FLAGGED — needs author adjudication]
- ヨーグルト (L125): the source says 「中性〜温め寄りに変化します」. Per §3 中性≈中庸→neutral, but 「温め寄り」 leans warm. Coded neutral to avoid over-reading; a defensible alternative is warm. This is the only non-binary attribution in the source.
- 甘酒 (L77-78): the item text is 「温めて飲むことで温活ドリンクに」 which is serving-temperature language, but the block header is 「体を温める発酵食品」(L71) and L104 lists it plainly among 温め飲み物, so it is coded warm on the header per §3 rather than moved to serving_temperature_items.

[QUESTION-STYLE HEADINGS] None in this source; all headings are declarative.

[SERVING TEMPERATURE]
- 朝の冷たいスムージー (L116-117, repeated L135): 「体温が最も低い朝に冷たいものを飲むのは特に冷えにつながりやすいです」— about the drink being cold, not about a smoothie's intrinsic nature. Also L127 mentions スムージー with no direction.
- Adjacent serving-temperature advice that does NOT change a coding: バナナ・スイカ・メロンに「常温で食べるのがベター」(L113) and 緑茶・麦茶・コーヒーに「温かくして少量に」(L104) — those foods already carry explicit nature attributions (cool), so they stay in foods.
